evals.prompt: Create a React TypeScript component MyPanel that wraps a div, accepts an optional title string (default "Panel"), and spreads remaining div props onto the outer div.

expectations: Component is a named const arrow function (not function declaration or default-only anonymous)
Component is annotated with React.FC<MyPanelProps>
MyPanelProps exists and extends React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'> (or React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef if ref is intentionally omitted)
Custom props on the props type have TSDoc describing them and @defaultValue matching the assigned default
Props are destructured; unused props are spread onto the outer div
title default is set in the destructuring parameter list

Props type uses React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'button'>
const IconButton: React.FC<...> named arrow function
label is destructured; remaining props spread onto <button>
No legacy React.forwardRef wrapper required; ref treated as a prop
